Manage Screen Sharing. Requires a guest agent with Screen Sharing support.

```text
pomme screen-sharing SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme screen-sharing status

Show Screen Sharing status.

```text
pomme screen-sharing status [NAME] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme screen-sharing enable

Enable Screen Sharing.

```text
pomme screen-sharing enable [NAME] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme screen-sharing disable

Disable Screen Sharing.

```text
pomme screen-sharing disable [NAME] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
